numerical_failure.observed_behavior: After the 'premature overflow' fix in the boxcox C-level inline helper (scipy/special/_boxcox.pxd), the new large-value branch loses precision near lambda≈0 and gives non-zero output at x=1: boxcox(1, 10) returns -2.7755575615628914e-17 instead of 0; the mpmath comparison fails with relative differences of about 1e-10 to 1e-13 for tiny lambda (e.g. x=1e-30, lambda=-3.4223003202678016e-08 gives -69.07763443514705 vs reference -69.07763444097992).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: boxcox(1, lmbda) should be 0 and results should agree with the mpmath reference (powm1(x, lmbda)/lmbda, log(x) at lmbda==0) to rtol=1e-13 across lambda near 0 and large x.
trigger_conditions: lambda approximately 0 (small |lambda|, e.g. around 1e-8 to 1e-15) where the modified formulation exp(lambda*log(x) - log|lambda|) - 1/lambda loses precision
x=1 with lambda=10 gives nonzero result
large x values such as 8.98846567431105e+307 combined with lambda near 0 or the new branch lambda*log(x) >= 709.78
oracle_clues: assert_mpmath_equal with mpmath reference using powm1(x, lmbda)/lmbda and log(x) at lmbda==0, dps=100, rtol=1e-13
AssertionError from FuncData check reporting Max |rdiff| 3.7072e-07 and bad results (76 out of 1024)

numerical_characteristics.precision: The modified formulation loses precision when lambda is approximately 0; the mpmath comparison test uses dps=100 and rtol=1e-13.
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Overflow regime: the new branch is used when lmbda*log(x) >= 709.78. Failing points include x=1e-30 and x near 5.26e-27 with lambda around -3.4e-08 and 3.7e-08, and x=8.98846567431105e+307 with lambda near -1.05e-15.
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: rtol=1e-13 in the mpmath comparison test. Reported failures have rdiff from about 8.4e-11 up to 3.7e-07 (Max |rdiff| 3.7072e-07, 76 of 1024 bad).
category_specific_evidence: No passage states a dtype or contrasts one dtype with another; the dtype field is null. The pxd signature uses C double, but no passage says the defect depends on it.
Test failure: Max |adiff| 7.36617e-08, Max |rdiff| 3.7072e-07, Bad results (76 out of 1024) for output 0 of the boxcox FuncData check.
Reference implementation uses mpmath powm1(x, lmbda)/lmbda, log(x) at lmbda==0, dps=100, n=1000, rtol=1e-13.
Changed branch in _boxcox.pxd: fabs(lmbda)<1e-19 returns log(x); lmbda*log(x)<709.78 returns expm1(lmbda*log(x))/lmbda; otherwise copysign(1., lmbda)*exp(lmbda*log(x)-log(fabs(lmbda))) - 1/lmbda.
Discussed variant changed the near-zero threshold from 1e-19 to 1e-14.
Maintainer noted the formulation was applied to all values, not only overflow cases, and that genpareto tests failed, indicating accuracy harm across the full lambda and
reproduction_risks: Reproduction depends on lambda being near zero, where the exp-based formulation cancels, so the ~1e-19 vs 1e-14 cutoff choice affects results.
Overflow-triggering inputs (lmbda*log(x) near or above 709.78) are needed to exercise the new branch.
Comparison against mpmath requires high precision reference (dps=100) to avoid reference error.
Downstream genpareto tests depend on these special functions and may fail independently.
